scheme_name: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Medical Benefit for Major Ailments
other_conditions: Applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehicles such as cars, taxis, luxury taxis, light commercial vehicles, vans, auto‑rickshaws, tempos, lorries, trucks, or buses
Vehicle used must be for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹20,000 for treatment of major ailments and up to ₹60,000 for major surgeries.
